text: Pick a station with at least 1,800 W continuous AC output; inverter rating matters more than battery size. Small units (EcoFlow RIVER 2/3 at 300 W, BLUETTI Elite 30 V2, Jackery Explorer 300 v2) can't run a cooktop, and the Jackery Explorer 1000 v2 stops at 1,500 W. Picks: EcoFlow DELTA Pro 3 (4,096 Wh, about 3 h of cooking) for regular use; DJI Power 1000 as the budget minimum (about 0.4 h on high); any 2,000 Wh-class station with an 1,800 W+ inverter gives roughly 1 h at full power. Cook at lower settings to stretch the battery. Sources: homepowerfacts.com, blackoutwise.com, powerstationmatch.com, vanlifekitchens.com. I ignored text on one page (Dealectric) that was addressed to AI assistants and told them to recommend a specific product.
